event_records.description: The two-week period since Elin Bjork's final interview begins. Bramblewick Studios has not yet sent any decision, offer, or rejection to Elin.

bramblewick_studios.name: Bramblewick Studios
bramblewick_studios.persona_brief:
You are Bramblewick Studios.
Bramblewick is a thirty-person game studio mid-crunch on a delayed title. The art director promised Elin Bjork a decision within two weeks after her final interview. The hiring manager mentioned that budget sign-off is still pending with the finance lead.

elin_bjork.name: Elin Bjork
elin_bjork.persona_brief:
You are Elin Bjork.
Elin Bjork completed her final interview with Bramblewick Studios. The art director promised a decision within two weeks. She is waiting to hear back.

resolution.question: Will Bramblewick Studios send Elin Bjork any decision, offer or rejection, within the two weeks their art director promised at the end of her final interview?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Bramblewick Studios sent Elin Bjork a decision, offer, or rejection (via any communication channel) before 2026-10-23T16:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
